beats.say: Every wild Narcondam hornbill lives on one small volcanic island.
It's just six point eight square kilometres, about twice New York's Central Park.
It sits alone in the Andaman Sea, over a hundred kilometres from North Andaman.
beats.cap: Andaman Sea · 100+ km of open sea

beats.say: It's an old volcano, seven hundred and ten metres tall.
Why its own hornbill? Open sea cut it off.
Isolated there, its hornbills slowly evolved into their own species.
No other Asian hornbill has a smaller range.
About a thousand live here, among the densest hornbill populations on Earth.
One lonely volcano made a bird found nowhere else.
